verified_points: Boosts apply to one token address on one chain and all pairs where it is base token.
Boosts enhance visibility and Trending Score for a limited 12 to 24 hours.
Boosting does not guarantee trending rank.
The API documents exact-token paid orders and top/latest boost lists.
Most public app.bsky GET requests may be sent to public.api.bsky.app without authentication.
searchPosts accepts q, sort, since, until, limit and cursor.
A cursor may not allow traversal of all results and hitsTotal can be rounded or truncated.
